title: Expanded stellar-population redshift holdout
status: Computational holdout of published catalog data; conditional empirical test, not raw-data or void/gravity test
selection: SBF-only distance modulus and uncertainty; 10<=D_L<=150 Mpc; 0<sigma_mu<=0.30 mag; exclude all 68 groups used in previous pilot. One smallest-SBF-error representative per 1PGC group, ties by PGC. No redshift selection.
split: 24 RA bins x 4 equal sin(dec) bins, assigned after representative selection; SHA256('time-redshift-sbf-v2:'+tile) first 8 hex modulo 10: 0..5 training,6..7 validation,8..9 test. No split retries.
primary_time_model: static_flux: z=exp(W(k D_L/c))-1; static Euclidean geometry, photon conservation, wave and envelope time stretching; D_L=r(1+z), z=exp(k r/c)-1.
primary_comparator: flat FLRW: Omega_m=0.3, Omega_Lambda=0.7 fixed, no radiation; D_L=(c/k)(1+z) integral_0^z du/sqrt(0.3(1+u)^3+0.7); fitted k=H0. It is a specified reference cosmology, not a fit of all cosmological parameters.
diagnostics: uniform_proxy: z=exp(k D_L/c)-1, reproduces earlier distance-as-path approximation, physically incomplete
pilot_static_fixed: static_flux with k frozen at earlier pilot value, no new fit
fitting: Each fitted model has one parameter k in [10,150] km/s/Mpc. Gaussian NLL in CMB-frame catalog cz, fixed 300 km/s motion floor plus first-order propagated SBF modulus uncertainty. No individual motion corrections, intercept, or held-out tuning. Validation is diagnostic only; all model metrics reported.
uncertainty: Conditional training profile delta NLL=0.5 plus 1000 training sky-tile bootstrap draws seed 9102026; fit uncertainty and shared systematics omitted from individual nominal prediction bands. Paired test sky-tile bootstrap 5000 draws seed 9202026, RMSE and mean NLL differences. Independence between tiles is approximate.
artifacts: Write protocol before label fitting; prepare separate label files; train reads only training labels; save frozen parameters; predict reads features and frozen parameters only; save prediction hash before scoring held-out labels.
limitations: These are galaxies measured from stellar-population fluctuations, not isolated stars.
SBF calibration and bandpass corrections are used as published; not rederived under the new theory. Catalog methods share calibration.
Galaxy group membership uses catalog construction assumptions; exclusion and sky blocking do not remove every correlation.
No matter-density, void path, potential, or acceleration measurements; environment dependence untested.
Motion floor is phenomenological, not a full correlated flow likelihood; no selection-function correction.
No rotation-curve or lensing test; no dark-matter replacement established.
Static propagation rule is stipulated, not a metric or dynamical field theory; stationary clock-rate gradients alone do not yield cumulative redshift.
